shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Ultra-Smooth Stumble Guys Battles 🏃‍♂️💨
shortIntro.para1: Stumble Guys is a chaotic, fast-paced multiplayer knockout game where up to 32 players compete for glory. Smooth controls, stable FPS, and instant jump reactions are key — one laggy tap can send you flying off the map!
shortIntro.para2: Even though it looks colorful and simple, the physics-based bounces, fast map transitions, and crowded rounds make device optimization essential to avoid freezes, stutters, or teleporting characters.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended specs to run Stumble Guys perfectly on Android and iOS. This guide is based on esports-level testing, player feedback, and real in-game performance across multiple devices.

recommended.Storage: 1GB free recommended for maps, skins, and events
recommended.Internet: Low-ping 5G or high-quality Wi-Fi to prevent teleport lag and stuck jumps

ios_intro: iOS devices perform exceptionally in Stumble Guys thanks to Apple’s tight hardware-software optimization. Even with 32-player lobbies, animations and inputs stay consistent.
fps_intro: While Stumble Guys isn’t a hardcore FPS title, higher FPS and smooth frame pacing drastically improve jump timing, dives, and collision reactions.

fps_list.fps: 60–120 FPS feel on 90–144Hz displays, excellent input response and instant jump control

settings_intro: To dominate rounds, optimize your device with these settings for smooth movement, instant jumping, and lag-free competitive play.

low_end.title: Graphics
low_end.value: Set to LOW for faster movement and less frame drop

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close all to avoid jump delay or teleporting

high_end.title: Refresh Rate
high_end.value: Enable 90Hz/120Hz for super crisp jumps and collisions

high_end.title: Game Booster
high_end.value: Turn ON to minimize stutter and maintain steady FPS

high_end.title: Thermal Control
high_end.value: Keep your device cool during long tournaments; overheated phones = slow jumps!

high_end.title: RAM Optimization
high_end.value: Keep at least 1–2GB free to load maps instantly and avoid stutters

storageIntroText: Stumble Guys’ storage usage includes maps, skins, animations, and seasonal events. Make sure you have enough free space for seamless updates and faster map loading.
faqIntroText: Frequently asked questions about Stumble Guys performance, optimization, and competitive gameplay:

faqList.question: Do I need a high-end device to win in Stumble Guys?
faqList.answer: Not really, but smoother devices help with precise jumps and faster reaction times in crowded lobbies.

faqList.question: Can I run Stumble Guys at 120 FPS?
faqList.answer: The game itself is capped internally, but devices with 90–144Hz displays feel significantly smoother.

faqList.question: Why do some rounds feel laggy even on good devices?
faqList.answer: Network instability or background apps can cause teleporting and delayed jumps — always close unnecessary apps.
